def extract_millisecond_segment(audio_data, start_ms, duration_ms):
    # Convert the audio data to a NumPy array
    audio_data = np.frombuffer(audio_data, dtype=np.uint8)

    # Create a new buffer to store the isolated audio segment

    # Save the isolated audio segment to a file
